stages.title: 第一節 · 圖上辨識（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 LU1 中府 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of LU1 Zhongfu on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：雲門下1寸，平第1肋間隙，前正中線旁開6寸。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: 1 cun below LU2, level with the 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline. Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: LU1 屬手太陰肺經。
knowledge.textEn: LU1 belongs to the Lung channel of hand-taiyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
optionsEn: Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 結論標明來源與不確定性。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
optionsEn: Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 ST3 巨髎 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of ST3 Juliao on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：瞳孔直下，平鼻翼下緣。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: Directly below the pupil at the level of the lower border of the ala nasi. Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: ST3 屬足陽明胃經。
knowledge.textEn: ST3 belongs to the Stomach channel of foot-yangming.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
optionsEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
optionsEn: Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 圖上辨識（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 ST41 解溪 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of ST41 Jiexi on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：踝關節前面中央凹陷，拇長伸肌腱與趾長伸肌腱之間（經穴）。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: Centre of the anterior ankle between the EHL and EDL tendons (jing-river). Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: ST41 屬足陽明胃經。
knowledge.textEn: ST41 belongs to the Stomach channel of foot-yangming.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
結論標明來源與不確定性。
正確標記禁忌與未知事項。
能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
optionsEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
Contraindications and unresolved items are identified.
Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 正確標記禁忌與未知事項。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
結論標明來源與不確定性。
optionsEn: Contraindications and unresolved items are identified.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 圖上辨識（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 BL41 附分 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of BL41 Fufen on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：第2胸椎棘突下旁開3寸。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: 3 cun lateral to T2. Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: BL41 屬足太陽膀胱經。
knowledge.textEn: BL41 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
optionsEn: Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 結論標明來源與不確定性。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
optionsEn: Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 圖上辨識（免費試學）

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 BL60 崑崙 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of BL60 Kunlun on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：外踝尖與跟腱之間凹陷（經穴）。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: Between the lateral malleolus and the Achilles tendon (jing-river). Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: BL60 屬足太陽膀胱經。
knowledge.textEn: BL60 belongs to the Bladder channel of foot-taiyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
結論標明來源與不確定性。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
optionsEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
能區分術語、觀察與療效證據。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
結論標明來源與不確定性。
optionsEn: Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
Can separate terminology, observations and efficacy evidence.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 骨度分寸與體表標誌
steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 KI7 復溜 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of KI7 Fuliu on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：太溪上2寸，跟腱前緣（經穴）。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: 2 cun above KI3 anterior to the Achilles tendon (jing-river). Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: KI7 屬足少陰腎經。
knowledge.textEn: KI7 belongs to the Kidney channel of foot-shaoyin.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
optionsEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 正確標記禁忌與未知事項。
結論標明來源與不確定性。
能說明模型與人體的差異。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
optionsEn: Contraindications and unresolved items are identified.
Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objective: 在教學示意圖上認識 GB23 輒筋 的區域與標誌。
steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of GB23 Zhejin on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：淵腋前1寸，第4肋間隙。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: 1 cun anterior to GB22 in the 4th intercostal space. Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: GB23 屬足少陽膽經。
knowledge.textEn: GB23 belongs to the Gallbladder channel of foot-shaoyang.

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍
knowledge.text: 定位標準用於名稱與位置溝通；引用該標準不代表本課已逐條驗證或證實療效。
knowledge.textEn: A location standard supports naming and communication; citing it does not mean this course is individually validated or that efficacy is established.

quiz.question: 「骨度分寸與體表標誌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proportional cun and surface landmarks'?
options: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
正確標記禁忌與未知事項。
結論標明來源與不確定性。
optionsEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
Contraindications and unresolved items are identified.
Conclusions identify sources and uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Human palpation and acupuncture practice require qualified training and professional supervision.

quiz.question: 「體位與模型限制」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Position and model limitations'?
options: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
能辨識停止條件並選擇專業求助。
optionsEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
Can identify stop conditions and seek qualified help.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.

knowledge.title: 學習界線
knowledge.text: 人體觸診與針灸實作屬合格訓練與專業監督範圍。

能說明模型與人體的差異。
用途主張與證據狀態分開記錄。
optionsEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.
Contraindications and unresolved items are identified.
Can explain the limitations of a model compared with a person.
Use claims and evidence status are recorded separately.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objectiveEn: Recognise the region and landmarks of EX-UE7 Yaotongdian on an educational diagram.
steps.instruction: 原始教材定位摘要（待逐條專業覆核）：手背，第2、3與第4、5掌骨間，腕橫紋與掌指關節連線中點，共2穴。請與 WHO 原文對照，僅在示意圖或模型上標記。
steps.instructionEn: Abridged source location, awaiting item-level professional review: On the dorsum between the 2nd–3rd and 4th–5th metacarpals midway between the wrist crease and the MCP joints. Compare with the original WHO text; mark only on a diagram or model.
steps.observation: 記錄標誌、來源版本與尚不確定的項目。
steps.observationEn: Record landmarks, source edition and unresolved questions.
steps.failure: 簡化畫面不呈現個別解剖差異，螢幕位置不能轉為人體進針位置。
steps.failureEn: A simplified screen omits individual anatomy; a screen coordinate cannot specify a puncture site on a person.
steps.check: 完成區域辨識與來源比對；不評定臨床定位能力。
steps.checkEn: Region recognition and source comparison completed; this does not assess clinical location skills.

knowledge.title: 所屬經脈
knowledge.text: EX-UE7 屬經外奇穴。

knowledge.title: WHO 標準範圍

steps.title: 體位與模型限制
steps.objective: 說明體位與個別解剖差異對定位的影響。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how position and individual anatomy affect location.
steps.instruction: 比較模型不同姿勢的體表標誌；把無法由圖確認的血管、神經或臟器位置列為未確定。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surface landmarks on model poses; label vessel, nerve and organ relationships that cannot be established from the image as unresolved.
steps.observation: 列出模型未呈現的至少兩種解剖差異。
steps.observationEn: List at least two anatomical variations omitted by the model.
steps.failure: 疼痛、酸脹或點選高分不能證明定位正確或操作安全。
steps.failureEn: Pain, soreness or a high click score cannot establish correct location or procedural safety.
steps.check: 能說明模型與人體的差異。
